name: mirage
text: Those numbers are bad and you're right to be angry. I also have to correct something I told you at 1:45: I said fair-odds coverage was fine at 98%. That was a mistake in how I counted (the log only keeps 1 in 25 of the requests we can't price, so they looked rare). Re-measured properly just now on 16,081 requests: 91% of the legs we can't price belong to games that are already IN PLAY (14% of all legs tonight; the engine deliberately doesn't price live games), and games not yet started are priced 98% of the time. Among the requests we CAN price, the biggest blocker is cash: 19.5% need more collateral than the free wallet has (a $10 parlay at a 20% chance needs $40 of cash; you have $45 free, shared with the bid desk and bets). So the honest answer is: more fills need either more free cash, or pricing live games (a real build, not a setting), or letting the parlay maker take cash from bids/bets. Which one do you want?
